scripts.build-feup: bash build/build-feup.sh && workers-php build ./feup-ltw-proj --out ./dist-feup --docroot . --entrypoint router.php && bash build/build-feup-static.sh
scripts.dev:feup: npm run build-feup --silent && wrangler dev --config wrangler.feup.jsonc
scripts.deploy:feup: npm run build-feup --silent && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.feup.jsonc
scripts.build-bindings: workers-php build ./examples/bindings-demo --out ./dist-bindings --docroot . --entrypoint router.php && cp -a examples/bindings-demo/style dist-bindings/style && cp -a examples/bindings-demo/assets dist-bindings/assets 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.dev:bindings: npm run build-bindings --silent && wrangler dev --config wrangler.bindings.jsonc
scripts.deploy:bindings: npm run build-bindings --silent && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.bindings.jsonc
